Based on what I found, here are real, currently-running free drop-in options for toddlers in Halton Hills:

```json
{
  "picks": [
    {
      "name": "Kids & Me Drop-In, Halton Hills Public Library – Acton Branch",
      "age_fit": "families with babies or children up to 6 years of age",
      "when": "Thursdays 10:30 a.m. to 12 p.m., following the school calendar starting the second week of September",
      "price": "free",
      "source_name": "Halton Region (Parenting Programs and Supports)"
    },
    {
      "name": "Kids & Me Drop-In, St. Andrew's United Church, Georgetown",
      "age_fit": "families with babies or children up to 6 years of age",
      "when": "Tuesdays 9:30 to 11 a.m., following the school calendar starting the second week of September",
      "price": "free",
      "source_name": "Halton Region (Parenting Programs and Supports)"
    }
  ]
}
```

A bit of context on these: 
"Kids & Me is a free weekly 1.5-hour parenting and early learning drop-in program for families with babies or children up to 6 years of age."
 
It's more than just a regular drop-in program as it follows a routine with a time for play, snacks, and stories, giving children an opportunity to practice moving from one activity to another.
 
These drop-in programs follow the school calendar (starting the second week of September) and are closed during the December/January holidays, spring/summer breaks and all statutory holidays.
 
Registration is not required.


I also found that Links2Care runs EarlyON Child and Family Centre drop-ins at multiple Acton and Georgetown locations 
where in-person programs let parents and/or caregivers participate together with their child to encourage positive interaction toward healthy social, physical, intellectual, and emotional development
 — but their page only pointed to "current schedule available on website" without a specific day/time I could verify, so I left it out rather than guess.
